inputs.question: On the landscape plan (Sheet 31), what tree species are proposed near the overhead electric line shown on the southern boundary? Are proposed trees positioned within 10 lateral feet of the OHE line? What species are shown and are they identified as utility-compatible?
inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of overhead transmission conductors are not from Utility Compatible Shade Trees list, or site grading does not meet required clearances from transmission facilities
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent question explicitly asks 'Are proposed trees positioned within 10 lateral feet of the OHE line?', which is a direct clearance/distance measurement question between trees and the overhead electric conductor. While the question also includes species identification (a generic element), the primary and compliance-critical inquiry is the lateral distance measurement.
